ng-migrate.description: Superseded by `transloco migrate angular-i18n`, to be deprecated in Transloco v10. Migrate from Angular i18n to Transloco.

ngx-migrate.description: Superseded by `transloco migrate ngx-translate`, to be deprecated in Transloco v10. Migrate from @ngx-translate to Transloco.

keys-manager.description: Add the Transloco CLI to your project, with the scripts that extract and find the translation keys.

join.description: Superseded by `transloco join`, to be deprecated in Transloco v10. Join the translation files into one.

split.description: Superseded by `transloco split`, to be deprecated in Transloco v10. split the translated files over the project's translation files.
